question: An object is placed on the principal axis of a lens of power – 10 D, at a distance of 15 cm. The image formed is _______ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**virtual and erect.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Image formation by the concave lens when the Object is placed at a Finite Distance from the Lens**

 
 
• When the object is positioned in front of the concave lens at any fixed distance.
 
• The concave lens's** optic center (O) and focus (F) **are where the resulting image will be formed after refraction.
 
• The object will have a larger size than the image.
 
• The image formed at – **Between F1 and the optical center**
 
• The nature of the image formed – **Virtual and Erect**
 
• The size of the image formed – **Diminished**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calculations**

 
 
• ​**Power = –10 D****
 Object distance, u= -15cm

 We know, **P= 1/f**

 -10= 1/f

 f= -1/10

 f= -0.1m= -10cm

 **By lens formula, 1/v-1/u= 1/f**

 1/v- 1/ (-15) = -1/10

 1/v+ 1/15= -1/10

 1/v= -1/10- 1/15

 1/v= -3-2/30

 1/v= -5/30= -1/6

 **v= -6cm**

 **For magnification, m= v/u**

 m= (-6)/ (-15) = 2/5

 **m= 0.4**
 
• Image formed is virtual, erect and diminished. **
